text: #736, step 2 of #566's plan, recorded at #738's merge. Refines D-0054 and D-0301 and keeps D-0311, D-0314, D-0379 and D-0393. invariant check-repository is the CI entry point for a configured repository. It loads .invariant/repository.json only from the committed base, never the working tree, and stages committed blobs privately. A repository without the file keeps modeled-only operation and needs no Docker; invalid configuration or revisions fail. A factory pull request has its issue's ratified native plan, writer's comment, execution authority at both the merge base and the current base, scope and pinned acceptance checked before anything is installed, and never falls back to ordinary checks. An ordinary pull request selects parts by captured ownership; a push, an empty diff or an unreliable selection checks every part. Checks run through the existing dependency preparer and offline sandbox with the native Go, pytest, Vitest and Jest selectors, and any failed or unfinished result fails CI. The template invariant init writes now runs these checks, passes -issue only for a branch naming one, and discovers projects and plan records for guarded ratification. Setup and the watcher refuse an obsolete configured gate with manual upgrade steps, keeping modeled-only setups as they were. The build's sandbox has no Bash (#741), so its workflow tests couldn't run there, and the merger finished it by hand. An independent review then found real problems, now fixed with regression tests: staging refuses a committed directory laid out as a Git repository, whose configuration the sandbox's plain git would otherwise read outside Docker; both project loops refuse a path starting with -, which verify and ratification read as a flag; the verify step asks for Bash. Inert editor and pager variables no longer stop scope. #740 holds what #736's tests pin or miss, including modeled factory pull requests in configured repositories, and must land before intake is enabled. External intake stays disabled.
